evidence.positive: Staged demo-demo patient or2886-fake-e062ed57 (80 kg, adult) with case 90902 via the admin API, launched it as loopuser, and set operations.start_time to 60 minutes before now. Injected a rocuronium infusion whose only event is a STOP (POST /api/admin/infusion, eventDate 20 min ago), so its start-of-administration date is null (DB row infusion_events = [{eventType:STOP,...}]). Then POSTed /api/cds/medication-selection/{pmrn}/90902 with medicationIdentifier m-sugammadex as loopuser: HTTP 200, rule_not_fired_results gained a row rule_identifier=w-sugammadex-default-dose, explanation='No prior medications of ROCURONIUM or VECURONIUM' at 14:32:37Z, rule_failure_results stayed at 0 rows, and the app log had 0 'Error processing rule' lines. Next added a dated rocuronium infusion (START event 10 min ago, i.e. after case start) alongside the undated one and re-ran the selection: the rule now abstained with 'No TOF data in timeframe of interest' (details WEIGHT_KG=80), proving the dated intraop administration was found and the undated sibling was skipped rather than suppressing it. The sibling a-nmb-reversal-scan rule, which shares the lookup, abstained 'No TOF ratio reading since last NMB admin' in the same run with no failure row.
evidence.negative: Before adding the intraop dose, injected a dated rocuronium infusion whose START event was 90 min ago (30 min before the case start of 60 min ago) and re-ran the sugammadex selection: the rule still abstained 'No prior medications of ROCURONIUM or VECURONIUM' (rule_not_fired_results row at 14:32:57Z), so a dated administration before the operation start does not qualify as intraop and an undated administration does not qualify either. Only the START at 10 min ago (after case start) changed the explanation to 'No TOF data in timeframe of interest'.
evidence.red_check: Compiled the parent commit's ContextPatient.java (git show 669aa8648^) inside the app container with javac 25 plus lombok 1.18.46 as the annotation processor; javap confirmed the compiled lambda calls Date.before/Date.equals with no null guard while the shipped jar class has startedOnOrAfter. Copied ContextPatient.class and ContextPatient$ContextPatientBuilder.class into /app/classes/com/guided/orci/dto/rule/context/ (ahead of /app/libs on the jib classpath; recorded the orci-models jar sha256 319bb65e... first), docker-restarted the container, and re-ran the same sugammadex selection with the STOP-only rocuronium infusion present. Red: app log line 'ERROR ... RuleEngine : Error processing rule: w-sugammadex-default-dose' followed by 'java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "Object.getClass()" because "date" is null' at java.util.Date.before <- ContextPatient.lambda$getMostRecentIntraopMedicationAdministration$0(ContextPatient.java:197), and rule_failure_results gained rows for w-sugammadex-default-dose and a-nmb-reversal-scan (exception_class java.lang.NullPointerException, same message) at 14:34:35Z; the HTTP response was still 200 with no rule result, i.e. the guidance silently vanished exactly as the Sentry issue describes. Reverted by deleting the two shadow class files from /app/classes (directory's pre-existing ContextObservation classes untouched), confirmed the orci-models jar sha256 unchanged (319bb65e...), restarted, waited for readiness, and re-ran the selection: rule_not_fired_results row 'No TOF data in timeframe of interest' at 14:35:26Z, no new failure rows, and the log still contains exactly one 'Error processing rule: w-sugammadex-default-dose' line (from the red window).

caveats: The undated administration was produced through the admin infusion debugger (STOP-only event), not through an EMR/HL7 infusion message; the resulting infusion_events row has the same null-start shape the ticket describes.
The case start time was set by SQL because app-launch on the demo tenant leaves operations.start_time null; the rule falls back to evaluation time in that case, which the fix handles identically.

Only abstention paths of the rule were exercised (no TOF observation injected), since the fix sits in the administration lookup that runs before dose selection; the 16 mg/kg and TOF-based branches are covered by existing unit tests and SUG-001/SUG-002.
Validated against the docker image built from 5e0a6767f; the pre-fix class was compiled in-container, so runtime behaviour, not a deployed artifact, was the red source.

automation.assessment: The fix already ships with unit coverage: ContextPatientTest (STOP-only infusion, no-event infusion, dated bolus alongside undated infusion, exact-start inclusivity, pre-start exclusion, other category) plus a STOP-only abstain test in each of TOFSugammadexAdjustmentWarningRuleTest and NMBNoReversalNeededHighTOFRatioRuleTest. What is not locked in is the end-to-end path (admin infusion with STOP-only event -> medication-selection API -> no rule failure). qa-suite/clinical-rules/sugammadex.spec.ts already has the fixtures needed (addMedicationAdministration infusion type, evaluateMedicationSelection), so one supplemental e2e test is worth adding; nothing more.
proposed_tests: SUG-003 (@supplemental, sugammadex.spec.ts): case with a rocuronium infusion documented only by a STOP event plus a dated intraop rocuronium dose; select m-sugammadex and assert the w-sugammadex-default-dose result is present with no error and the a-nmb-reversal-scan result likewise has no error (rule_failure_results / results[].error empty).

SUG-004 (@supplemental, sugammadex.spec.ts): same case with only the STOP-only infusion; assert the rule abstains with 'No prior medications of ROCURONIUM or VECURONIUM' rather than erroring, and that a rocuronium START dated before case start also yields that abstention.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: With a rocuronium infusion documented only by a STOP event, selecting sugammadex on a live demo case evaluated the w-sugammadex-default-dose rule cleanly and a dated intraop rocuronium dose alongside it was still found.
Negative: A rocuronium dose dated before the case start, and the undated infusion itself, were both excluded and the rule abstained with no prior medications.
Red check: Swapping the pre-fix ContextPatient class into the running container reproduced the Sentry NullPointerException and a rule failure row for both w-sugammadex-default-dose and a-nmb-reversal-scan, then went green again after the class was restored.

Automation: Unit coverage shipped with the fix; one supplemental end-to-end sugammadex selection test with a STOP-only infusion is proposed.
